nodes.label: Phosmith Logo Mark
nodes.description: 240x240 transparent-background brand mark: five glowing cubic-Bezier streams fanning right from a single cyan origin node, with luminous waypoint nodes and two violet pixel diamonds. role=img + aria-label/title 'Phosmith'. The backgroundless sibling of public/logo.svg.
nodes.rationale: Opacities run hotter than the badge version (0.85/0.9 stream stops, 0.22 halos vs 0.72/0.78 and 0.18) because it must hold up on unknown/light surfaces where the dark badge's contrast boost is absent.

nodes.label: Five-Stream Bezier Fan
nodes.rationale: Five cubic Beziers all begin 'M 58,120' and fan top-right to bottom-right, mirrored about y=120 (streams 1/5 and 2/4 are reflections; stream 3 is the axis). Stroke weight encodes hierarchy — 2.8px cyan hero centre, 1.8px violet outer arcs, 1.2px accents — so the eye lands on the centre stream first. Depicts many signals refined into one processed output: the visual thesis of a photo-editing pipeline.

nodes.label: Origin Convergence Node
nodes.rationale: The single point (58,120) where every stream converges, built as six stacked circles: two hairline concentric rings (r22/r14, opacity ~0.2) reading as orbit, two blurred cyan fills for bloom, a solid r4.5 cyan core, and an r2.4 white specular highlight. The white dot is what makes it read as a light source rather than a flat dot.

nodes.label: Two-Family Glow Filter Set
nodes.rationale: Two deliberately distinct filter families. fB3/fB6/fB10/fB16 are blur-ONLY (no feMerge) so they are applied to separate throwaway halo shapes stacked beneath a crisp sibling. fG3/fG5 feMerge the blur UNDER SourceGraphic so a single element keeps a sharp core while gaining bloom. Filter regions are hugely oversized (up to 900% / -400%) because default -10%/120% clips a stdDeviation-16 blur into a visible square edge.

nodes.label: userSpaceOnUse Stream Gradients
nodes.rationale: lg1-lg5 use gradientUnits=userSpaceOnUse with x1/y1 pinned to the origin (58,120) and x2/y2 to each stream's endpoint, so colour advances along the true path angle instead of the bounding box's diagonal. Every ramp starts at stop-opacity 0 and ends near 0.1 — the strokes dissolve into the origin bloom and fade out at their tails so no hard stroke-cap is ever visible. The outer/inner pairs invert hue direction (violet->cyan on lg2, cyan->violet on lg4) to bind the two colours together.

nodes.label: Cyan-Violet Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Four literal tokens carry the whole identity: #06B8D4 cyan (primary/hero stream, origin core), #22D3EE bright cyan (highlight tail and far node), #7C3AED violet (outer arcs, secondary nodes), #8B5CF6 light violet (accent dots, pixel diamonds). Near-complementary cyan/violet on near-black; no colour is theme-driven, every value is inlined in each SVG.

nodes.label: Pixel Diamond Node
nodes.rationale: A 4.5x4.5 rounded square rotated 45 degrees about its own centre, sitting on the top and bottom arcs. The only non-circular element in the mark — a literal PIXEL turned on its corner, the one motif that states 'photo software' rather than generic network-graph.
